model_participation.note: Model absence is observed in this local tool; MODEL_ZERO_NATIVE physiology is not claimed. No new canonical model mode is defined.

budgets.limit_status: NO_HARD_WALL_OR_MEMORY_LIMIT_IMPLEMENTED; host caller must bound use; not native-safe scheduling
budgets.cancellation: Caller process interruption; no partial result or native commit; receipt chain is in-memory only

weave:evaluate.replay: SAME_PYTHON_CONFIG_INPUT; branch thresholds exact comparisons; no cross-backend decision parity claim
weave:evaluate.equality: Python float operations; threshold booleans exact within identical environment; no tolerance licenses changing decisions
weave:evaluate.failure: Nonfinite input or arithmetic: suppressed simulation result, null diagnostics plus path-classified residue; invalid Python types may raise; no native action
weave:evaluate.boundaries: Float diagnostics and exact status logic; receipt serialization is separate

numpy_backend:numpy_audit.equality: Five numerical outputs; rtol=2e-6 atol=2e-6 on tested finite inputs; booleans may differ at precision boundaries
numpy_backend:numpy_audit.failure: Wrong shape raises; nonfinite outputs possible; no admission or healthy-status interpretation
numpy_backend:numpy_audit.boundaries: 17 scalar inputs; ignores truth_signal and non-default WeaveConfig except risk threshold

jax_backend:jax_audit.equality: rtol=2e-6 atol=2e-6 on tested finite inputs; no whole evaluate parity
jax_backend:jax_audit.failure: JAX errors propagate; caller validates finite output; no native clearance
jax_backend:jax_audit.boundaries: Raw numerical kernel, not a validated proposal interface

jax_backend:jitted_jax_audit.equality: Same bounded kernel tolerance as jax_audit
jax_backend:jitted_jax_audit.failure: Compilation/device errors propagate; nonfinite results remain invalid evidence
jax_backend:jitted_jax_audit.boundaries: JIT wrapper uses default risk threshold

receipts:canonical_json.equality: UTF-8 sorted keys, compact separators, allow_nan=false; Python JSON representation, not RFC8785
receipts:canonical_json.failure: Unsupported values, cycles or excessive nesting raise; no append

receipts:ReceiptChain.append.equality: SHA-256 of strict canonical_json unsigned envelope
receipts:ReceiptChain.append.failure: Serialization fails before append; in-memory single-writer operation is not durable or crash-atomic native commit
receipts:ReceiptChain.append.boundaries: Calls structural JSON serializer; no native write or I/O

receipts:ReceiptChain.verify.equality: Previous digest recurrence from zero head; exact equality
receipts:ReceiptChain.verify.failure: Mismatch returns false; malformed values may raise; not signature or authority verification
receipts:ReceiptChain.verify.boundaries: Witness history recurrence is not native learning

cli:main.equality: Evaluation profile plus exact receipt serialization; environment metadata varies
cli:main.failure: Argument/runtime/I/O errors propagate; no external or native action
cli:main.boundaries: Local sample demonstration, not native execution

execution:describe_invocation.equality: Source digests exact; runtime/platform versions captured at observation
execution:describe_invocation.failure: Unavailable package versions null; file-read failures propagate
execution:describe_invocation.boundaries: Read-only runtime evidence; no proof a named backend executed
